description.en: Finds the cover of your video games, even when one source is down: Rawg, then Twitch, then Steam. No code is required; a wrong cover is fixed in a few clicks.
description.fr: Trouve la jaquette de vos jeux vidéo, même quand une source est en panne : Rawg, puis Twitch, puis Steam. Aucun code n'est obligatoire ; une jaquette fausse se corrige en quelques clics.

privacy.en: Collects nothing about your visitors, who never contact RAWG, Twitch or Steam: your site's server fetches each cover once, keeps a copy (300 at most) and shows it from its own address. The server sends the game title to RAWG (with your code, if set), to Twitch (through the Twitch connector, if set up) and to Steam's public store. A Twitch copy lasts 24 hours at most; the others 30 days by default.
privacy.fr: Ne collecte rien sur votre public, qui ne contacte jamais RAWG, Twitch ni Steam : le serveur de votre site va chercher chaque jaquette une fois, en garde une copie (300 au plus) et l'affiche depuis sa propre adresse. Le serveur envoie le titre du jeu à RAWG (avec votre code, si vous en avez un), à Twitch (par le Connecteur Twitch, s'il est réglé) et au magasin public de Steam. Une copie de Twitch dure 24 heures au plus ; les autres 30 jours par défaut.

label.fr: Connecteur Twitch (facultatif) : les jaquettes de boîte de Twitch servent quand RAWG n'a pas de réponse

mcp.name: rawg_covers_to_check
mcp.description: Lists the game titles whose cover is doubtful (the game found is not an almost identical title, or two games looked as good), the 100 most recent first. Each has: title (as asked by a module), foundGame, source (rawg, twitch or steam), rawgId (RAWG only), coverUrl (the source's address, for information), candidates (how many games were proposed) and checkedAt. Pass "title" to also get up to 6 candidate games per source to choose from (source, gameId, rawgId for RAWG, name, year, platforms, coverUrl); it asks each available source once. The owner fixes titles in the Game covers module; with the right to, you can use rawg_cover_set. No key is ever shown.

title.description: Optional. A title from the list (or any title): also returns up to 6 candidate games per source with their gameId, year and main platforms.

search.description: Optional, with title: other words to look for (for example the game's real name).

mcp.name: rawg_covers_list
mcp.description: Lists the covers the module keeps, newest first: the ones the owner corrected (origin "corrected"), the games left without a cover ("none") and the covers the site found by itself ("auto", at most 1000 kept, doubtful or not). Each has: title, origin, game (name, may be empty), source (rawg, twitch or steam; null when none), coverUrl (the source's address, for information, or null) and at. Optional filters: "search" (words of the title) and "origin"; 50 per call by default (100 at most), with "total" for the whole list. Nothing is changed and no key is ever shown. To change or forget one, ask the owner, or use rawg_cover_set with their consent.

search.description: Optional. Words of the game title to look for.

origin.description: Optional. Only the covers corrected by the owner, left without a cover, or chosen automatically.

limit.description: Optional. How many to return (50 by default).

mcp.name: rawg_cover_set
mcp.description: Saves the right cover for one game title, for the whole site (modules get it at once). Pass "title" and exactly ONE of: rawgId (the right RAWG game), gameId with source ("twitch" or "steam"; the right game chosen among the candidates of rawg_covers_to_check), none=true (no cover for this title), imageUrl (an https://media.rawg.io/media/... picture), forget=true (remove the saved correction). The picture comes from the source's own answer and is copied onto the site; no other address is ever used. At most 1000 corrections are kept. Changes the pictures visitors see: ask the owner before using it.

title.description: The title as modules ask for it (as shown by rawg_covers_to_check).

rawgId.description: The RAWG id of the right game, taken from the candidates of rawg_covers_to_check.

search.description: Optional, with rawgId or gameId: the words used to find the candidates (when you listed them with a different search).

none.description: true: this title gets no cover at all.

imageUrl.description: An https://media.rawg.io/media/... picture chosen by the owner. No other address is accepted.

forget.description: true: forget the saved correction of this title (the automatic choice comes back).

gameId.description: With source: the id of the right game at that source, taken from the candidates of rawg_covers_to_check.

source.description: With gameId: the source of the chosen game.
